_comment: chimera.visible_monkey.volume_spec.v1 -- THE VOLUME ROUTE CONTRACT (CT/MRI -> segmentation -> marching cubes). Pattern: the morphosource_ct pipeline laws (p95 threshold measured per specimen, morphological open+close, min-component filter, marching cubes at 0.5, mm scaling, sha256 receipt, <=30k-face previews). One spec per specimen/modality; nothing is hardcoded. Run: python -B tools/science_funnel/visible_monkey_volume_route.py build volume_spec.json
_modality_note: ct_mri_density = the proven density-histogram route (paired 3T MRI + CT). 'serial_section_rgb' = the 2,967 color section images -- a THIRD modality whose thresholds differ (color space, not density): the route is HOOKED and refuses modality_untested until calibrated against real data (UNTESTED-against-real-data, honestly).

volume._note: reader auto tries imageio then PIL. offset is the signed shift applied after reading (the morphosource ImageJ stacks used -32768); the manifest records it.

_voxel_note: the REAL voxel spacing comes from the landed DICOM headers, measured at run time when available and recorded here; never copied from another specimen

segmentation._threshold_note: THE LAW, not a number: p95 of the measured density histogram (morphosource_ct measured 118 for 000875604, 148 for 000875599 -- two specimens, two numbers, one law). 'law': 'fixed' is legal only with fixed_value + reason, recorded in the manifest.

outputs._note: bulk meshes stay OUT of git (gitignored); the receipt (sha256 per file) and manifest land in the validation appendix
